changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_workflow_definition d INNER JOIN ( SELECT task_permission_code, MAX(priority) AS keep_priority FROM m_workflow_definition WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY task_permission_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) keepers ON d.task_permission_code = keepers.task_permission_code SET d.status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.priority < keepers.keep_priority;

UPDATE m_workflow_definition d INNER JOIN ( SELECT task_permission_code, priority, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM m_workflow_definition WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY task_permission_code, priority HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) keepers ON d.task_permission_code = keepers.task_permission_code AND d.priority = keepers.priority SET d.status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.id <> keepers.keep_id;
